fieldValues.title: The archetypal flow: the ideal layer of Programme coordination
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
Nine stages, each what we are trying to achieve, in order: Sense (notice what matters and hear it), Make meaning (name the problem in its domain), Choose a response (a remedy, ranked by purpose), Shape the work (a good issue), Allocate (the right hands pick up ready work), Build (make the change once, in the right place), Review and land (a good pull request, safely merged), Decide (the right owner settles what governs later work) and Learn and remember (what happened changes what we do), which feeds Sense again.

The map is fractal. Each stage is a subdomain that refines Programme coordination. One trade-off per stage (owner, 2026-10-25, vignette d75aaf13: 'start with a single tradeoff, we have enough complexity'). Each stage first got three tensions, one per trigram line, each refining the parent's line: line 1 Refine ↔ Deliver, line 2 Compatibility ↔ One way, line 3 Adapter convenience ↔ Core once. Each pole records what leaning on it looks like and its shadow, the failure of leaning too hard. Where we went too far is recorded as the shadow we fell into, with evidence, and the recorded problems that sit in that shadow are linked to the pole (concerns).

The older model in the products repository (semantic_ops prompts and templates) used the same frame: three polarities per domain, Orientation (decisive action ↔ reflective awareness), Change dynamics (renewal ↔ preservation) and Perspective (tactical focus ↔ system-wide vision), plus an optional domain-specific wildcard; personas carried polarity preferences, and problems a felt tension and a tension map (vignette 86c06cdb). The stage's other two tensions stay as records under its domain, out of the map. Model B's evidence (container b9c5106b) is folded into each stage's exercise.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Across the stages (from model B): the owner's attention is the single sink (SP-113), and the process is re-founded instead of evolved (SP-114).
- Line 1 leans inward in most stages; line 2 keeps things side by side day to day, but the process itself is replaced whole.
- Deciding is not the bottleneck; decision form and execution are (SP-115, SP-02).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions:
- This is one model of the flow among several (owner, 2026-10-25, vignette bb916d7a): a second, independent model is being made to compare.
- The stage tensions are untested: no 2×2 cases, no cube, no yang assignment.
- Settled for this map (owner, 2026-10-25, vignette bb916d7a): a stage refines Programme coordination. In general domains can refine or overlap, and may overlap on different dimensions; the method has no relation for overlap yet.
fieldValues.next_action: Fill the four 2×2 cases for one stage's trade-off with the owner (Review and land is the best evidenced); then name the remedy that moves us out of each shadow.
